name: Gaussian Shear-Warp Visualization
aliases: Gaussian Volumetric Representation for Shear-Warp Visualization
Shear–warp Volume Rendering using Gaussian Representation
definition: A continuous Gaussian field representation optimized from sparse voxel supervision to enable efficient slice-based compositing and real-time volumetric visualization.
summary: Gaussian Shear-Warp Visualization approximates volumetric data with learnable Gaussian kernels to enable efficient, adaptive stacking rendering that requires only one slice stack regardless of camera orientation.
